Package org.cyclops.integratedtunnels.command

Class CommandGenerateTunnels.TunnelsGenerationHelper

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integratedtunnels.command.CommandGenerateTunnels.TunnelsGenerationHelper
Enclosing class:
CommandGenerateTunnels
public static class CommandGenerateTunnels.TunnelsGenerationHelper extends Object
Helper class for tunnel network generation logic, shared between command and game tests. All presets are built on top of the same grid layout: cable planes at even Y levels, and a checkerboard of cables and free "cells" at odd Y levels. Every cell is a free position that is surrounded by cables of a single network, so it can hold a container that is observed or targeted by parts on the surrounding cables.

    • DEEP_CELLS

      public static final int DEEP_CELLS
      The number of cells that the "deep" preset uses. This is chosen so that the preset observes fewer positions but more total slots than generateItemInterfaces(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, int), which is what makes it "deep": 64 completely filled chests hold 1728 slots, against 160 chests holding 1440 slots.
